name: 40-google-plain-system-prompt
description:
convertGooglePrompt (prompt-converters.js:432-623) with useSysPrompt true. The two leading system turns are shifted off the input array (:436-450) and become system_instruction.parts; example_user gets 'User: ' glued on (:438-442) while example_assistant is already 'Iris: '-prefixed, so that branch short-circuits before the group predicate is reached (:443-447); the un-named user turn falls into the general `name: ` branch (:502-506); the two consecutive user turns merge with '

' (:600-605); and 'gemini-1.5-pro' is not a no-prefill model, so the trailing assistant turn stays 'model' (:462-467). Expected: system_instruction.parts = [{'text':'User: Hello there'},{'text':'Iris: Good evening'}]; contents = [{'role':'user','parts':[{'text':'User: Real question

Second question'}]},{'role':'model','parts':[{'text':'Real answer'}]}]; and `messages` is mutated in place (two shifts, role rewrites, `name` deleted from both named turns).
